basics.name: Xiaoqi Qin
basics.label: Sophomore Undergraduate Student in Mechatronics Engineering
basics.summary: Research interests: World models and embodied intelligence. Highlights: End-to-end, hands-on experience building a multi-view video world model on top of lingbot-world (a 14B, DiT-based, action-conditioned video diffusion model) on 16×H200 GPUs—owning the data-and-conditioning pipeline and the adapter/LoRA model-adaptation training within a collaborative research team.

work.name: Peking University — Supervisor: Prof. Hao Tang
highlights: Research Topic: Multi-view first-person video world models—building on lingbot-world (a 14B, DiT-based, action-conditioned video diffusion model) with an explicit Map Memory spatial condition to generate cross-view-consistent Counter-Strike gameplay.
Data pipeline: Built and scaled the end-to-end data pipeline that transforms raw gameplay recordings into the model's Map Memory conditioning signals.

Model training: Implemented and trained the model-adaptation stack—a residual conditioning adapter that injects the Map Memory signal into the DiT backbone, together with LoRA fine-tuning—realizing an explicitly map-grounded approach to multi-view-consistent world modeling.
Literature & direction: Surveyed multi-view generation approaches (MultiGen, Multiworld, Gamma-world, MIRA) to inform the project's technical direction.
